X Archive Gallery v1.5.0 — Created by M.Nesuka
This software uses Qt/PySide6/Shiboken under LGPLv3 and FFmpeg under
LGPLv2.1-or-later. Qt and its FFmpeg playback libraries are dynamically
replaceable. The separate LGPL poster process has sources for its static
dav1d/zlib dependencies. The Gyan GPL executable and GPL-only Qt Virtual
Keyboard are not shipped.

Python, Pillow, ijson/YAJL, imageio-ffmpeg, OpenSSL, Mesa and compiler/Windows
runtimes retain their own copyright notices and original license terms.
PyInstaller's bootloader exception permits non-free application distribution.
The application's Source Available license does not limit third-party rights.

See THIRD_PARTY.md, source-manifest.json, original notices in this folder,
LIBRARY_REPLACEMENT.md, and the matching ThirdPartySources ZIP supplied on
the same GitHub Release as the app ZIP. These source archives are supplied
directly; an upstream source link alone is not used as a source-delivery offer.
